question: Owner 2026-10-28: run the paper accounts in the framework with the 1m model (features through the minute before the touch, trained before 2026) deciding which levels rest an order.
single_variable: Resting-order selection score: frozen model on the 5m bar before the touch (earlier run) -> 1m model at the minute before the touch; account rules, fills and sizing unchanged.
excluded_symbols: BTC, ETH, XAU, XAG, PAXG, XAUT (none are in the Codex alt inputs)
fees: Codex config maker 0.02 / taker 0.05 percent (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23)
not_modelled: OKX vs Binance data and symbol lists; the paper engine's 1m intrabar order; manual reductions
in_sample: Rules, thresholds and filters were chosen on the same history; forward paper data is the test
score_columns: causal = 1m model (resting decision), stored = frozen touch-bar score (leaky reference)
out_of_sample: 2026-01-01 to date only; 2020-2025 is the 1m model's training period
resting_semantics: The order rests at the level before the touch; a 1m decision one minute before the touch gives the same limit fill as the 5m-bar submission in Codex's orders
